parameters.query: INSERT INTO `groups` (name) VALUES (CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($2) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = name;

INSERT INTO verify_apps (domain, group_id)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT jt.domain, g.id AS gid
  FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($1) USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS (domain VARCHAR(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$.domain')) AS jt
  JOIN `groups` g ON g.name = CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($2) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
) AS src
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_id = src.gid;

INSERT INTO verify_records (app_id, group_id, report_date, reported_at, severity, latest_snapshot_time, snapshot_count)
SELECT a.id, g.id, DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 7 HOUR), UTC_TIMESTAMP(), jt.severity, jt.latest_snapshot_time, jt.snapshot_count
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($1) USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS (
  domain VARCHAR(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci PATH '$.domain',
  severity VARCHAR(10) PATH '$.severity',
  latest_snapshot_time DATETIME PATH '$.latest_snapshot_time' NULL ON EMPTY,
  snapshot_count INT PATH '$.snapshot_count' NULL ON EMPTY
)) AS jt
JOIN verify_apps a ON a.domain = jt.domain
JOIN `groups` g ON g.name = CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($2) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
